supplemental_items.interpretation: Scalar offset requires exact int type (excluding bool and subclasses), nonnegative and key index or suffix Index. Identity sequences under the two exact names become lists and offset eligible parts only; other parts are retained without recursion inside that special route. Ordinary tuples outside the special route are returned unchanged. Dict and list instances are copied recursively.
